title: Sorption of arsenate on cerium oxide: a simulated infrared and Raman spectroscopic identification
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1896-1907
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00894D, Paper

Khoa Minh Ta, Deyontae O. Wisdom, Lisa J. Gillie, David J. Cooke, Runliang Zhu, Mário A. Gonçalves, Stephen C. Parker, Marco Molinari
Cerium oxide is an optimal sorbent. Arsenate adsorbs in stable 4-fold and 5-fold coordination, which need inclusion in fitting EXAFS spectra. Such sorption has characteristic simulated Raman and Infrared spectra.
